method: Native runtime frames opened with view_image; full-round output validated by screenshots.mjs.
checks: HUD and game field do not overlap.
Both player paddles remain distinct and readable.
Ball contrast and motion trails remain visible at native resolution.
Serve instructions and terminal overlay are readable.
No image filtering, placeholder asset URLs or clipped default control legends.
limitations: Paddle-game primitives are intentionally geometric; these packs do not solve humanoid fighter art or unrelated genres.
Visual inspection used the native 256×224 framebuffer, not a physical CRT or cabinet controls.

Generic B-only probes report no visual change because B is a movement modifier; behavioral tests verify its slower motion. P2 A has no serve effect until P2 owns the serve, and its power-return role is verified in a complete P2-winning match.
